task: Design critique of the Booth tab (Director's Console) found real bugs and design gaps. Fixed all 3 Critical items and all 7 Warning items in one contained pass: a note-taking textarea that wiped itself mid-sentence and saved against the wrong segment, raw internal segment ids leaking into user-facing text, keyboard-unreachable manuscript lines, a UI-font reading surface instead of the reading tokens, an over-emphasized Regenerate button, low-contrast active-segment highlight, silent autoplay, auto-scroll fighting manual scrolling, a triple-rendered chapter title, and inert empty-state copy.

frontend/src/pages/ChapterEditor/compone.summary: CRITICAL #1 (note self-wipe): added a `notingSegmentId` pin, separate from the playback-driven `activeSegmentId`. Pin is set on textarea focus (or first keystroke as a fallback); while pinned, the sync-from-storage effect no longer overwrites `noteText` when the active segment changes underneath it. Save persists against the pinned segment, not whatever is active at save time. Pin releases on Save, on a new Cancel button, or on blur when the note is empty. The active-segment/'note for' label shows which segment is pinned. CRITICAL #2 (raw ids): added a required `groupNumberBySegmentId: Map<string, number>` prop (same derivation `FollowAlongPanel`/`useRenderGroups` already produce) and replaced every raw-id render ('Active Segment: {activeSegmentId}', 'Segment: {anno.segmentId}') with the human-readable render-group ordinal ('Active Segment: N' / 'Segment N'). Warning #10: replaced the inert empty-state copy ('No notes for this chapter yet.') with action-teaching copy ('Notes you leave while listening appear here. Click a line to jump there, then jot a note.').

Warning #9: dropped the `chapterTitle` prop and the redundant 'Chapter: {title}' line — the chapter title already renders in the workspace header and the global player bar. Warning #5: de-emphasized the Regenerate button from a full-width, bold, --text-primary-on-surface button to a small inline-flex ghost button (--text-muted, transparent background, 400 weight, auto width) so it no longer reads as the hero of the card.

CRITICAL #3 (keyboard reachability): each manuscript line now has `role="button"`, `tabIndex={0}`, an `onKeyDown` handler firing the same `seekToSegment` as click on Enter/Space, and `aria-current="true"` on the active segment. Added a `.sr-only` `role="status" aria-live="polite"` region announcing 'Segment N of M' only when the derived render-group ordinal actually changes (tracked via a ref), not on every playback tick. Warning #7 (silent autoplay): a `pulseSegmentId` state + `autoplayPulseRef` apply a one-shot CSS pulse class to the first segment that resolves active after the mode-entry `playChapter` call; the animation is gated by `prefers-reduced-motion` in CSS. Warning #8 (auto-scroll fights manual scroll): a scroll listener on the reading column sets a `suspendAutoScroll` flag with a 4s grace timeout on user-initiated scroll (distinguished from our own programmatic `scrollIntoView` via an `isAutoScrollingRef` guard); the karaoke auto-follow effect skips while suspended. Stopped passing the now-removed `chapterTitle` prop to `FollowAlongPanel`; passes the new `groupNumberBySegmentId` map to `AnnotationsPanel`.

frontend/src/theme/components.css.summary: Warning #4 (reading surface): `.review-text-view` now uses `var(--font-reading)` + `var(--surface-reading)`; `.review-text-view__segment` uses `var(--type-reading)`/`var(--leading-reading)` instead of a flat 0.75rem UI-font size. Warning #6 (low-contrast active highlight): added a non-color `border-left: 3px solid var(--accent)` gutter bar to `.review-text-view__segment--active` alongside the existing tint/weight change. Added `.review-text-view__segment--pulse` + `@keyframes booth-autoplay-pulse` for the one-shot autoplay acknowledgment, with a `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` override disabling the animation (matching the existing `.switch__knob` convention in this file).

frontend/tests/unit/pages/ChapterEditor/.summary: Updated all render calls to pass the new required `groupNumberBySegmentId` prop; changed the raw-id assertion ('Segment: seg-1') to the ordinal assertion ('Segment 1'). Added 3 new tests: typing a note survives `activeSegmentId` changing underneath it and saves against the pinned segment (not the segment active at save time); no raw internal segment id ever appears in rendered output; the pin releases on blur when the note is empty. R1 revert-check performed: with the pre-fix AnnotationsPanel.tsx (via `git stash`), 4 tests failed for the expected reasons (raw id assertions, note-wipe assertion, missing pin label) before the fix was restored.

Added 2 new tests: segments carry `role="button"`/`tabIndex="0"` and respond to Enter/Space the same as a click (and ignore other keys); the currently active segment carries `aria-current="true"` while other segments do not.

flow_impact: AnnotationsPanelProps gained a required `groupNumberBySegmentId` prop (only consumer is BoothTool/index.tsx, which already computes this map via useRenderGroups — no other callers exist). FollowAlongPanelProps dropped `chapterTitle` (only consumer is BoothTool/index.tsx, updated in the same change). No backend/API contract changes. Do-not-touch files (Cast/Revise/Write tool files, DirectorsConsole/index.tsx, DirtyGuardContext.tsx) were left untouched. Item #5 was scoped to a restyle-in-place (ghost button, still in FollowAlongPanel) rather than physically relocating it inline near the active segment — the instructions flagged that move as optional ('possibly moved') and relocating it into the segment list would have required plumbing re-render state through every segment row, judged out of proportion to the de-emphasis goal for this pass.
